summary: Antiphon release candidates (CARD-0599). Desktop tag. 08:30 and 16:30 Europe/London. Cuts an immutable RC, runs the full rc profile, publishes on green.
description: SSH-bridge wrapper for the RC lane. It cuts release/rc-<UTC stamp> from origin/master in the producer-owned clone at C:\Antiphoneleases\checkout, pins the full SHA once, then runs scripts/nightly-run.ps1 -Profile rc -Trigger rc -Ref <candidate> -ExpectedSha <sha> against the candidate's own state root, and publishes a CalVer tag plus GitHub Release only on RC complete-green. RC green earns release credit only: it never writes the master attempt, green, monitor or Interim qualification receipt, and cannot repair a failed, missing, stale or overdue scheduled master run. Trigger provenance is derived from WM_SCHEDULE_PATH, not from a caller argument. Contention on the shared native-run lock records deferred-busy and waits for the next slot. NOT REGISTERED: this definition is inert until CARD-0599 S6 applies it. Do not add a Windows Scheduled Task.
content:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
# CARD-0599 D-7: scheduled/rc credit comes from the runner's own schedule context.
SLOT="${WM_SCHEDULE_PATH:-}"
if [ "$SLOT" != "u/lndcobra/antiphon_release_candidates" ]; then SLOT=manual; fi
ssh -i /tmp/windmill/worker_to_windows -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes lndco@host.docker.internal "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\src\Antiphon\scripts\release-cut.ps1 -ScheduleSlot $SLOT -JobId ${WM_JOB_ID:-}"
exit $?
